qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md: Gates must exclude convincing dead apps; evidence standards
evidence: Frozen tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23-27 requires a newly authored distinctive marker in both rendered preview and console after Run, so an editor/static sample alone fails. Constraints judge.toml:23-29 requires a normal new UI write, an observed response, then identical identity/title/filename/source in a clean independent browser context and after reload; health, static JSON, same-context storage or a toast alone do not pass. Both use binary all_pass. tests/test.sh:212-227 executes gates and score.py before scored; scoring.toml:1-3 gives both gates zero reward mass and score.py:40-48 zeros failed gates. Functional prompt:5, Polish:13-22 and Visual:31-40 restate the in-dimension gate, require usable workspace plus server-supplied library evidence, and prescribe complete dimension zero (Visual raw 1, normalized zero). The public app has no authentication (instruction.md:1 and app_context.md:8); none is invented. Gate prompts explicitly prohibit same-origin/schema requirements; app_context.md:20 allows CDN assets and :16 prevents missing Auto-run from globally zeroing unrelated working features. Confirmed bounded browser observations in evidence/29/results.json: dead Run had empty preview/console and Render=false despite server storage; client-only library with working authored Run, health 200 and fake successful write response had no new record in the clean context and Constraints=false; a server-rendered form/write/read alternative had both=true, with an off-origin application script, no JSON list endpoint and no Auto-run control. These are actual scripted fixture observations, not configured-judge grades or a complete-product certification. The first fixture run had an accessible-label driver error, retained as attempt1-fixture-label-error.json; only the reviewer fixture was corrected. All 1,384 frozen task files, 34 frozen rule files and all 21 indexed evidence hashes verified against their manifests. Existing surface-results.json independently reports the golden authored Run and clean-context saved readback, with its published runtime limits retained. No row-29 defect observed; configured judge, Oracle and portal results remain unmeasured and are not claimed by this Pass.
counterexample: Tried two convincing weak gate fixtures: a usable editor with a no-op Run and genuinely server-saved records; and real preview/console execution with localStorage-only saves plus a static successful write response. The former fails the authored-output prerequisite; the latter fails fresh-context retrieval. Tried a gate-conforming server-rendered alternative with arbitrary write route, 303 navigation, no JSON library endpoint, off-origin app asset and no Auto-run control; it satisfies the stated global prerequisites. Results and hashes are in per-row-review/evidence/29/.
